data.name: AuditKit.Subtitle
data.value: Everything you hand to the tax inspector for a period, in one archive.

data.name: AuditKit.Contents
data.value: The kit holds the FEC and its validation report, the integrity attestation of the anti-fraud chain with the sealed archives of the closings, the reliable audit trail (who created, validated and issued each document), the invoices as XML and Factur-X PDF, and the log of transmissions to the accredited platform.
